name: SureMDM
summary: SureMDM from 42Gears manages Android, Windows, macOS, Linux and iOS devices. Its three plans list at $3.99, $5.49 and $7.99 per device a month, with no minimum device count and volume pricing on request. The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency or the billing period behind each figure.

facts.text: Device enrollment settings let admins set device naming and authentication, restrict enrollment by platform, OS version or model, and customize agent permissions for Android and macOS.
The Android Enterprise page says administrators can remotely lock or wipe devices in case of loss or theft, and describes policies such as password rules and application restrictions.
On Android devices in Device Owner or Device Admin mode a wipe factory-resets the device and removes the agent, while in Work Profile mode it removes only the work container and its apps.
The pricing page lists Premium and Enterprise add-ons SureAccess at $1.99 per device a month and SureIdP at $3.49 per user a month.
The pricing page offers a free trial but does not state its length, and links to a separate refund policy page.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 3 admin users. Annual billing is listed as saving 20%. The page does not say which period the shown price reflects

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 25 admin users. Annual billing is listed as saving 21%

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited admin users. Annual billing is listed as saving 11%

hiddenCosts: The page does not say whether the displayed prices are monthly or annual rates.
The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency, and says applicable taxes may vary.
SureAccess ($1.99 per device a month) and SureIdP ($3.49 per user a month) are add-ons for Premium and Enterprise only.
The page says to contact 42Gears for volume pricing.
